Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages is used to signal key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the type of system event for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: Consolidated Quotation Message
Message.Description: Consolidated BBO will broadcast a real-time update every time the Consolidated BBO across Nasdaq owned and operated exchanges is updated throughout the trading day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Denotes the best bid price, or the highest price for market buy order(s) in the execution system.

Field.Name: Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the execution system at the best bid price.

Field.Name: Best Offer Price
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq exchange's best offer price, or the lowest price for market sell order(s) in the execution system.

Field.Name: Best Offer Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the execution system at the best offer price.

Field.Name: Best Bid Exchanges
Field.Description: The Exchange(s) the best bid information is relative to (Appendix E).

Field.Name: Best Offer Exchanges
Field.Description: The Exchange(s) the best offer information is relative to (Appendix E).

Message.Name: Retail Price Improvement Message
Message.Description: Indicates a retail interest indication of the Bid, Ask or both the Bid and Ask for Nasdaq-listed securities. Populated for the Nasdaq Texas market only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the execution system.

Field.Name: Buy Side Rpi Exchanges
Field.Description: The Exchange(s) of buy-side RPI the information is relative to (Appendix E).

Field.Name: Sell Side Rpi Exchanges
Field.Description: The Exchange(s) of sell-side RPI the information is relative to (Appendix E).

Message.Name: Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community. The message originates from the Nasdaq market center system.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue.

Field.Name: Reason Code
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or Market Watch code for the trading state change.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Restriction Message
Message.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator. Sends updates for the Nasdaq market only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the short sale restriction indicator message is being generated.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates stock directory messages for all active Nasdaq and non Nasdaq listed security symbols. The Stock Directory can be sent again during the trading day if any value changes.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Listing Market / Category: indicates listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For Nasdaq-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if Nasdaq system limits order entry for issue

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in Nasdaq systems in a live/production, test, or demo state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the Nasdaq security is set up for IPO release.

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP).

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index. Leverage Factor is rounded to the nearest integer below.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index.

Message.Name: MWCB Decline Level Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients what the daily MWCB breach points are set to for the current trading day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Decline Level message was generated. Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Level 1
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 1 Value.

Field.Name: Level 2
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 2 Value.

Field.Name: Level 3
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level 3 Value.

Message.Name: MWCB Status Message
Message.Description: Informs data recipients when a MWCB has breached one of the established levels.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the MWCB Breaker Status message was generated. Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Breached Level
Field.Description: Denotes the MWCB Level that was breached.

Message.Name: IPO Quoting Period Update
Message.Description: Indicates the anticipated IPO quotation release time of a security. Populated for the Nasdaq market only.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the IPO Quoting Period Update message was updated. Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Time
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO release time, in seconds since Epoch 1/1/1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Qualifier
Field.Description: IPO quotation release qualifier

Field.Name: IPO Price
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO price to be used for intraday net change calculations.

Message.Name: Operational Halt Message
Message.Description: The Exchange uses this message to indicate the current Operational Status of a security to the trading community, for the three market centers operated by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the Operational Halt message was generated. Timestamp represented in nanoseconds since Epoch 1/1/1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Code
Field.Description: The Market Center the Operational Halt is in effect for

Field.Name: Operational Halt Action
Field.Description: Operational halt action
